scope: Proposition 6.3 of the manuscript “Integrable metrics and effectivity with controlled boundary” (preprints/Integrable-metrics-and-effectivity-with-controlled-boundary-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 068 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 79cff3abcc899987), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X and Z be connected smooth projective varieties, let g : Z → X be a birational morphism, and let f : Z → Y be a surjective morphism to a connected smooth projective variety of positive dimension. Put L = −KX, and assume L has a smooth Hermitian metric h with semipositive curvature. Let E = KZ/X be the effective Jacobian divisor. Assume rank f∗OZ(E) = 1. Let S be the set of prime divisors G on Y such that every prime divisor of Z dominating G is g-exceptional. Suppose there is an open patch over the smooth base-change locus of f, disjoint from E, on which the curvature of g∗h dominates a positive multiple of the pullback of a Kähler form on Y . Then there is an effective integral divisor A supported on S and a singular metric on M = −KY + A, with psh weights ψ, such that the metric is smooth and strictly positively curved on a nonempty open subset of Y and e−ψ |sA|2 ∈ L1+η loc for some η > 0. (6.6) Here |sA| means the absolute value of the coefficient of the canonical section in a local holomorphic frame.
